channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Amen Thompson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Amen Thompson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rafael Stone on Free throws, Amen Thompson
item.description:
Rafael Stone on Amen Thompson:

“I think he's a very, very good basketball player. Since about halfway through his rookie year, we've been a materially better team when he's on the court. And he keeps getting better. I thought he had a really good year last year. He just got better and better and better and better. And he helps our team on the court in literally every way you can. We turn the ball over less, we turn the other team over more, we rebound better, we shoot a higher percentage, we shoot free throws better. Everything's better with Amen Thompson. So yeah, we're very, very high on him.”

Rafael Stone on Free throws, Amen Thompson, Oct 9, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Reed Sheppard on Amen Thompson
item.description:
Reed Sheppard on what looks different about Amen Thompson from last season:

“I mean, everything. The shot looks really good. It's a lot smoother, and his body looks different. He also had a big summer gaining some weight. You can tell he's been in the gym and improving.”

Reed Sheppard on Amen Thompson, Sep 27, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Amen Thompson, Joe Johnson
item.description:
Draymond Green on Joe Johnson comments about Amen Thompson getting paid $200 million with no jump shot:

“I do think number one, you get paid for what you’ve done. I think there’s always this idea of you get paid for what you’re going to become. No, no. In this league you get paid for what you you’ve done. Amen Thompson has put together a body of work that says if you want to keep me, this is going to be the going rate. Now, yes, he needs to improve. But on the flip side, I do get a little frustrated sometimes when people come out like, “Yo, this guy can just gain a jump shot.”

Draymond Green on Amen Thompson, Joe Johnson, Sep 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Amen Thompson
item.description:
Kevin Durant on the Amen Thompson game winner:

“Twin saved the day. I remember him saying when I hit that GW against that 'team from the dessert' he said that was his favorite moment as a Rocket and I was like nah this gotta be the one now”

Kevin Durant on Amen Thompson, Mar 22, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Ime Udoka on Amen Thompson, Stephen Curry
item.description:
David Hardisty:Ime Udoka on containing Stephen Curry tonight:

“When you have a special guy like Amen Thompson doing what he does, that's the result.”

Ime Udoka on Amen Thompson, Stephen Curry, Apr 7, 2025. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Steven Adams on Amen Thompson
item.description:
Steven Adams on Amen Thompson:

“One of a kind, bro. I haven't played with anyone like this. His speed is unbelievable. His second jump, first jump, is so quick off the ground. I haven't seen that type of athleticism, to be honest.”

Steven Adams on Amen Thompson, Jan 6, 2025. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.
